answer: Edges in the trust graph decay 10 percent per epoch, so a vouching made once is worth 0.35 after 10 epochs and 0.12 after 20. Peers who disagree on a grade dilute the payout to a third. No identity audits its own recruit, which removes the cheapest collusion loop. A ring of 30 accounts that only vouch for each other reaches a zenith of 1.0 internal weight and 0.0 external reach, and the harbor never sees them. Cost per maintained edge is one attestation per epoch, and a willow of stale edges buys nothing.
